Squads: your group chat, with a leaderboard

A squad is your friend group inside ontap. Everyone logs their nights, and the squad page keeps score: who's out tonight, who's leading this week, and the recap at the end of the month.

By the ontap team · 28 October 2026

What's in a squad

  • Who's out: squad members out right now, at the top of your feed.
  • Week, Month or All time: switch the leaderboard view.
  • The race: a chart of the month, lead changes and all.
  • Squad Last Call: a shareable recap card for the group chat or your story.

Start one in a minute

  1. Get ontap and add your friends.
  2. Create a squad and share the invite code.
  3. Go out. The squad page does the rest.

It's about nights out together, not about who drinks most: squads count nights, spots and moments as much as pints. Please drink responsibly.

Get your friends on ontap and start a squad. It's free.

Get ontap free on the App Store

FAQ

How many people can be in a squad?

Squads work best for a friend group; invite everyone you go out with.

Do squads cost anything?

No, squads are free.
